A centralized relational system for connected airline operations

The project brings essential airline logistics records into one structured database. It links aircraft and flights with crew assignments, passenger loyalty, specialized cargo, emissions, and disruption events.
Search and maintain linked records through a browser console.
Capture fuel and CO₂ at flight level for later analysis.
Use joins, aggregates, grouping, and subqueries to answer operational questions.

Airline logistics crosses teams, systems, and time-sensitive decisions
Flight and aircraft status can drift across separate records.
Crew assignments must stay connected to flights and duty details.
Temperature-sensitive goods need handling requirements and checkpoints.
Causes and delay duration need a consistent event history.
A shared relational model links operational events to the flight that anchors them.
